name: The Wild Oak
description: A family-run Lindon venue in a repurposed historic apple-orchard warehouse on 1.6 acres, with a European-inspired ballroom (19-foot ceilings), landscaped grounds with a pergola patio, fire pit and marriage grove, and in-house bar, decor, floral and day-of coordinating services.

items.label: Description
items.value: A family-run Lindon venue in a repurposed historic apple-orchard warehouse on 1.6 acres, with a European-inspired ballroom (19-foot ceilings), landscaped grounds with a pergola patio, fire pit and marriage grove, and in-house bar, decor, floral and day-of coordinating services.

items.label: Style words
items.value:
Timeless elegance
Modern design meets rustic charm
European-inspired ballroom

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Ceremony add-on — $350
Before 10am — $100/hour; after 11pm — $350/hour
Peak-season Thursday-Saturday weddings require at least 2 add-ons: bar service, day-of coordinating, decor or florals ($3,000 minimum)
Decor packages, florals, bar service, day-of coordinating, graphic design — prices not stated
Clean-up crew (required with food trucks) — $150

items.label: Standing
items.value:
250 max for revolving guests (wedding pricing page)
300 for flowing events indoors (2023 event brochure)

items.label: Rooms
items.value:
Bride's private room
Groom's private room

items.label: Included items
items.value:
Hand-planed black walnut tables and reclaimed 60" round tables
150 cross-back wood chairs
Black walnut cake table
Live-edge walnut buffet table and 2 wood buffet tables
Guestbook table
Gift table
Glass bar (indoor) and wood bar (outdoor)
Bistro lights on pergola patio
Wooden arch by rock waterfall
Red brick fireplace
Gas fire pit

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value:
Venue decor team sets up and cleans up selected decor
Clean-up crew — $150 (required when using food trucks)

items.value: Outdoor patio under a pergola with bistro lights

items.label: For rent
items.value:
Decor packages with a la carte items (prices not stated)
In-house florals: centerpieces, bouquets, ceremony arch and aisle arrangements (prices not stated)
Graphic design: welcome signs, seating charts, menus (prices not stated)
Bar service, alcoholic and non-alcoholic (price not stated)

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Mezzanine for DJ or bouquet toss
Pergola-covered patio

Marriage grove

Preferred caterer list; outside caterers allowed if licensed, insured and approved by the venue
Any food truck welcome ($150 clean-up crew required)
Client handles all communication with the caterer

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value: Large kitchen for caterers and vendors

items.label: Alcohol
items.value: Venue holds a liquor license; in-house bar service (alcoholic and non-alcoholic) offered as an add-on

items.label: Preferred caterers
items.value: Marvellous Catering; Lux Catering; Magleby's Catering; 4 Forks Catering; Utah Celebrations Catering; El Camino Kitchen; State Street Catering; Savory Peaks Catering

items.label: Outside caterer
items.value: Allowed if licensed, insured and approved

items.label: Food trucks
items.value: Any food truck; $150 clean-up crew required

items.label: Times
items.value:
All-day rental 10am-11pm
Before 10am — $100/hour; after 11pm — $350/hour
Sunday by inquiry

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Set-up and take-down must fit within rental hours
Peak-season Thursday-Saturday weddings require at least 2 add-ons
Outside caterers must be licensed, insured and approved
Food trucks require the $150 clean-up crew

items.label: Parking
items.value:
Close parking and handicap parking
Reserved parking for bride and groom
Lot holds 72 cars plus overflow parking (2023 event brochure)

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Event hostess on site during events (2023 event brochure)
Separate hourly pricing for non-wedding events
Capacity figures differ: 250 revolving guests (wedding page) vs 150 seated / 300 flowing (2023 brochure)

items.label: Services
items.value: Bar service (alcoholic and non-alcoholic); Day-of coordinating; Decor packages + a la carte; Florals; Graphic design
